title: Intergenerational Learning Seminar I
description: Provides a unique opportunity to develop relationships with Indigenous community, students and faculty in urban, remote or isolated areas that will be sustained throughout the program. Using a peer-led and intergenerational mentorship approach, issues related to integrating Indigenous knowledge of wellness and advanced nursing knowledge and practice are explored and discussed.
notes: Course registration is limited to students enrolled in Master of Nursing: Indigenous Wellness stream, or with permission of the department.
